capabilities: Chat with coding agents from a sidebar with streaming Markdown responses
Attach notes, selections, folders, and images as agent context with @ mentions
Approve, deny, or queue agent permission requests and queued messages
Run multiple agent conversations in tabs with session history and resume
extras: Desktop only (mobile unsupported). Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README carries extensive security disclosures: agents run as local child processes that can read, write, and execute commands per their permission mode, sessions are stored under .obsidian/plugins/agenthub/sessions/ and may be picked up by sync or Git, and dangerous modes like bypassPermissions require repeated confirmation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run coding agents against your vault; you have to leave the app and work in a terminal without note context.

relations.evidence: A desktop Obsidian plugin for working with Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode
working with Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and other coding agents
Use BRAT to try beta versions before they reach the community directory.

provider account signed in through each agent's CLI
provider subscription or API usage, depending on provider

summary: Sidebar chat client for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI and others) that runs them as local processes with your notes as context.
